MODEL GENERAL CONTRACT FOR PROCUREMENT OF GOODS AND SERVICES
(Sourced from GeM Public Procurement Framework - Anonymized Reference)

This Agreement is entered into on 1st November 2026 between:
[Procuring Authority / Buyer], having its office at New Delhi, India (hereinafter "Buyer"), and
[Supplier Company Private Limited], a company incorporated under the Companies Act with office at Bengaluru, Karnataka (hereinafter "Supplier").

1. SCOPE OF SUPPLY
The Supplier shall supply the goods and perform the related services specified in the Schedule of Requirements.

2. PAYMENT TERMS
The Buyer shall release payment within thirty (30) days from the date of final acceptance of goods. Any statutory deductions shall be made as applicable.

3. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. The courts of New Delhi, India shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY
Each party agrees to maintain confidentiality of proprietary technical information disclosed under this Agreement for a period of two (2) years.

5. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party.
